disease_profiles.name: Hereditary spherocytosis
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: RBC membrane-cytoskeleton failure; splenic extravascular hemolysis
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Supportive/folate; selective splenectomy with vaccine risk planning

disease_profiles.name: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: IgG-mediated RBC phagocytosis at physiologic temperature
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Hemolysis, spherocytes, usually DAT IgG positive

disease_profiles.name: Cold agglutinin disease
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: IgM-triggered classical complement activation and C3-mediated hemolysis
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Cold-associated acrocyanosis, C3-positive DAT, elevated cold agglutinin titer
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Avoid cold, treat underlying clone if needed, selected complement inhibition

disease_profiles.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Somatic PIGA mutation, loss of CD55/CD59, alternative-complement hemolysis
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Complement inhibitors for qualifying patients; meningococcal vaccination/prophylaxis

disease_profiles.name: Acquired severe aplastic anemia
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Pancytopenia with hypocellular marrow; exclude clonal/nutritional causes
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: HLA-matched transplant where suitable or ATG/cyclosporine/eltrombopag

disease_profiles.name: Primary immune thrombocytopenia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Autoimmune platelet destruction and impaired production
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Isolated thrombocytopenia; diagnosis of exclusion; no defining marrow lesion
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Corticosteroid-based initial care when indicated; TPO-RA/rituximab and other agents

disease_profiles.name: Immune-mediated thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Anti-ADAMTS13 autoantibodies cause ultra-large VWF multimer microthrombi
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Emergency plasma exchange, immunosuppression, often caplacizumab per guidelines

disease_profiles.name: Congenital thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Recurrent congenital TMA, severe ADAMTS13 deficiency without inhibitory antibody
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: ADAMTS13 replacement using plasma or recombinant product as available

disease_profiles.name: Complement-mediated hemolytic uremic syndrome
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Alternative complement dysregulation causing endothelial TMA
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: MAHA/thrombocytopenia with kidney injury; exclude STEC-HUS and TTP
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Prompt specialist assessment and complement inhibition for selected cases

disease_profiles.name: von Willebrand disease
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Deficient or dysfunctional VWF impairs platelet adhesion and FVIII stabilization
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Mucocutaneous bleeding, VWF antigen/activity and FVIII testing
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Tranexamic acid, desmopressin for responsive types, VWF concentrates when needed

disease_profiles.name: Hemophilia A
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Inherited FVIII dysfunction impairing intrinsic tenase
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Deep-tissue or joint bleeding; low FVIII, isolated aPTT sometimes prolonged
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: FVIII prophylaxis or nonfactor approaches; inhibitor-aware care

disease_profiles.name: Hemophilia B
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Inherited FIX deficiency impairing intrinsic tenase
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Joint and muscle hemorrhage; low FIX activity
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: FIX replacement/prophylaxis and individualized emerging therapies

disease_profiles.name: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: ITGA2B/ITGB3 defect impairs GPIIb/IIIa platelet aggregation
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Normal platelet count with impaired aggregation except ristocetin response

disease_profiles.name: Bernard–Soulier syndrome
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Platelet GPIb-IX-V defect impairs VWF-mediated adhesion
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Macrothrombocytopenia, absent ristocetin agglutination not rescued by plasma
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Supportive hemostasis; platelet therapy for severe bleeding

disease_profiles.name: Polycythemia vera
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Elevated Hct/RBC mass, JAK2, low EPO, panmyelosis on marrow
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Risk-adapted phlebotomy, low-dose aspirin if suitable, cytoreduction for high-risk

disease_profiles.name: Essential thrombocythemia
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Sustained platelets, enlarged hyperlobulated megakaryocytes; exclude pre-PMF

disease_profiles.name: Primary myelofibrosis
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Clonal inflammatory megakaryocytic disease promotes reticulin/collagen fibrosis
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Leukoerythroblastosis, teardrop RBC, dry tap/fibrosis; pre-PMF vs overt
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Symptom-directed JAK inhibitors, anemia/spleen treatment, selected allo-HSCT

disease_profiles.name: Myelodysplastic neoplasms
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Clonal ineffective dysplastic hematopoiesis with leukemia risk
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Persistent cytopenias, multilineage dysplasia, marrow/blast/molecular classification
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Risk-adapted supportive/transfusion, hypomethylators, lenalidomide for del5q and transplant
